checked.agreement: Only complete exact declared meaning signatures; excludes reviewer ID/time/free notes/source-authority evidence refs; partial declarations retained and not admitted or given complete signatures.

checked.declaration_not_authentication: Read evidence pins and closing bytes; identity/independence/source authority/currentness/reviewer blindness/actual adjudication all false; no evidence content interpretation or signature verification.

checked.geometry_separate: Explicit chosen complete normative declaration and evidence; interval geometry only via unchanged packet owner, no flat target construction or semantic admission.

limitations: Static review only; inert tests not executed by reviewer.
Caller-supplied reviewer/adjudicator IDs and timestamps are declarations; no authentication or independence proof.
Raw archival views/provenance revalidation does not reopen original374MBexport or establish official current law.
Geometry applies to supplied literal anchor intervals; declared normalized/paraphrased rule atom text is not equated with anchor surfaces, nor is role semantics reviewed.
Completeness refers to filled review/context slots; identity/process/exposure evidence may still be absent, and all masks remain0.
Exact agreement is conservative and includes ordered anchor/attachment metadata; it is not semantic equivalence.
Dictionary API cannot verify original submission file bytes or recover duplicate keys discarded before invocation; strict parse_json_bytes is supplied for file callers.
Resolver behavior and original producer computation are not cryptographically attested.
method: Complete v01 static review plus exact v01/v02 source/test diffs and corrected declared-role set/regression inspection; AST parsing only.
